issues.desc: background.md uses project-specific jargon (wrapper-root, metadataRoot, configuredGitRootStatus) without an initial definition in the background text itself. index.json description provides partial context (wrapper-root project (metadataRoot is not a git repo, configured gitRoot resolves)), but a first-time reader of background.md alone would encounter these terms undefined at the first sentence of the Trigger Event section.
